<thought>Since the direct esterification precursor (the acid) and simple vinyl‑silane reagents are not commercially available, I searched for a single‑step cross‑coupling that can directly assemble the target from two buyable building blocks. A Hiyama coupling of a commercially available (trimethylsilyl)acetylene (C#C[Si](C)(C)C) with a commercially available methyl 4‑bromocinnamate (COC(=O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1Br) can form the required C=C bond and give the target methyl ester in one step. Both reagents are listed as buyable, and their combined price is well under the $125 limit. The appropriate retrosynthetic template for a Hiyama coupling (template_id = 2105) is available in the database. This satisfies the requirement of ≤ 1 step with commercially available leaves.</thought>
